purpose: In-scope evidence for the narrowed TypeB wording: under the K=5 hard-bin severity rule fitted on the calibration segment, TypeB windows concentrate in the lowest severity bins, so severity conditioning applies almost no within-group differentiation there.
population: V=1 (all 12 targets valid) paths; groups are the post-hoc taxonomy of Section 3 (diagnostic only, cf. Appendix sec:appendix:d3).
